objective: Improve legal move policy quality without degrading the frozen value readout
architecture: Frozen v1.37 ordered38 conditional pattern projections -> quantize/clamp -> D4 tied38→16C→64 clipped-ReLU MLP -> residual correction to original64 policy logits -> legal mask/softmax
featureReuse: Reuse the38 pattern projections already computed by the baseline; preserve their spatial order instead of pooling them away. Encoder/table/trunk/value/gates and original policy are frozen. The global correction head executes once per board.
spatialSymmetry: The three pooled groups/global32 vector are D4-invariant and cannot alone encode which board coordinates rotate. Ordered38 pattern features permute under D4; both MLP matrices are tied under simultaneous input/hidden/output transformations, with hidden4x4 maps.
initialization: Frozen approved v1.37 weights; zero output correction starts exactly at baseline full predictions
selection: Proposed next experiment: validation legal-policy cross-entropy; report top1 alongside CE. Keep value unchanged; candidate test only after selection. Native speed gate required before full training/strength matches.
caveats: This is a PyTorch structure prototype, with no trained candidate, native kernel, measured throughput or strength result.
Tied weights reduce trainable parameter count; the dense multiply-add estimate still counts every expanded matrix operation.
Global scalar projections contain less local detail than full32-dimensional per-square embeddings; whether the new interactions improve policy must be tested.
